concierge.definition: n. a French caretaker of apartments or a hotel; lives on the premises and oversees people entering and leaving and handles mail and acts as janitor or porter

concierges.definition: n. a French caretaker of apartments or a hotel; lives on the premises and oversees people entering and leaving and handles mail and acts as janitor or porter
concierges.translation: n. 看门人, 门房( concierge的复数形式 )

conciliabule.definition: n. An obscure ecclesiastical council; a conciliable.
conciliabule.translation: 秘密交谈, 交头接耳

conciliarism.translation: n. 教会会议,至上主义

conciliarist.translation: n. 教会会议至上主义者

conciliarists.translation: (conciliarist 的复数) n.教会会议至上主义者

conciliate.definition:
v cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
v come to terms
v make (one thing) compatible with (another)
conciliate.translation:
vt. 安抚, 说服, 博得...的支持, 调和
[法] 调解, 安抚, 抚慰

conciliated.translation: v. 使（某人）息怒或友好, 安抚, 劝慰( conciliate的过去式和过去分词 ); （使）意见一致, 调节

conciliates.definition:
v cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
v come to terms
v make (one thing) compatible with (another)
conciliates.translation:
n. 安抚者, 劝慰者( conciliate的名词复数 )
v. 使（某人）息怒或友好, 安抚, 劝慰( conciliate的第三人称单数 ); （使）意见一致, 调节

conciliating.definition: p. pr & vb. n. of Conciliate
conciliating.translation: v. 使（某人）息怒或友好, 安抚, 劝慰( conciliate的现在分词 ); （使）意见一致, 调节

conciliation.definition:
n. the state of manifesting goodwill and cooperation after being reconciled
n. any of various forms of mediation whereby disputes may be settled short of arbitration
conciliation.translation:
n. 说服, 安抚, 抚慰, 调和
[经] 调解

conciliationist.translation:
n. 调和主义者
a. 调和主义的

conciliations.definition:
plural of conciliation
n. the state of manifesting goodwill and cooperation after being reconciled
n. any of various forms of mediation whereby disputes may be settled short of arbitration
conciliations.translation:
(conciliation 的复数) n. 说服, 安抚, 抚慰, 调和
[经] 调解

conciliative.translation: a. 安慰的, 融和的

conciliator.definition: n. someone who tries to bring peace
conciliator.translation:
n. 抚慰者, 调和人
[经] 调解人

conciliators.definition:
plural of conciliator
n. someone who tries to bring peace
conciliators.translation:
(conciliator 的复数) n. 抚慰者, 调和人
[经] 调解人

conciliatory.translation: a. 安抚的, 和好的, 调和的

concinnate.definition: v. t. To place fitly together; to adapt; to clear.
concinnate.translation: v. 将…作巧妙和谐的配合或拼凑

concinnity.definition:
n. Internal harmony or fitness; mutual adaptation of
   parts; elegance; -- used chiefly of style of discourse.
concinnity.translation: n. 妥贴安排, 优美, 和谐

concinnous.definition: a. Characterized by concinnity; neat; elegant.
concinnous.translation: a. 和谐的, 优美的

concise.definition: a. expressing much in few words
concise.translation: a. 简洁的, 简明的

concisely.definition: r. in a concise manner; in a few words

conciseness.definition: n. terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words
conciseness.translation:
[计] 简明性, 简洁性
[经] 简洁性

concision.definition: n terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words
concision.translation: n. 切断, 简明, 简洁

concitation.definition: n. The act of stirring up, exciting, or agitating.
